title: Auto-differentiable data assimilation: Co-learning of states, dynamics, and filtering algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2603.20891v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data assimilation algorithms estimate the state of a dynamical system from partial observations, where the successful performance of these algorithms hinges on costly parameter tuning and on employing an accurate model for the dynamics. This paper introduces a framework for jointly learning the state, dynamics, and parameters of filtering algorithms in data assimilation through a process we refer to as auto-differentiable filtering. The framework leverages a theoretically motivated loss function that enables learning from partial, noisy observations via gradient-based optimization using auto-differentiation. We further demonstrate how several well-known data assimilation methods can be learned or tuned within this framework. translated_title: 自动微分数据同化：状态、动力学与滤波算法的协同学习
translated_abstract: 数据同化算法通过部分观测来估计动力学系统的状态，而这些算法的成功应用依赖于代价高昂的参数调优以及采用精确的动力学模型。本文提出了一个框架，通过我们称之为“自动微分滤波”的过程，在数据同化中联合学习状态、动力学以及滤波算法的参数。该框架利用一个具有理论依据的损失函数，使得能够借助基于梯度的优化（使用自动微分）从部分且有噪声的观测中进行学习。我们进一步展示了如何在den框架内学习或调优几种著名的数据同化方法。为了凸显自动微分滤波的多功能性，我们在跨越多个科学领域的动力系统上进行了实验，例如航空航天工程中的 Clohessy-Wiltshire 方程等。
tldr: 本文提出了一种自动微分滤波框架，利用理论驱动的损失函数和基于梯度的优化，实现对状态、动力学模型以及滤波算法参数的联合协同学习，从而摆脱传统数据同化中昂贵的参数调优和对精确动力学模型的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an auto-differentiable filtering framework that jointly co-learns states, dynamics, and filtering algorithm parameters via a theoretically motivated loss function and gradient-based optimization, eliminating the need for costly parameter tuning and accurate dynamics models in data assimilation.
